title: A copy stays consistent when the live site runs Wordfence or an object cache
steps: Run the ignored-table, drop-in and prepend-line cases.
expect: A plugin state table only the live site has is added once, then kept as the copy's.
The live object cache drop-in never reaches the copy.
auto_prepend_file lines in the root server files are commented out, nothing else.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=plugin state table the copy has never had|object cache drop-in is the copy|Wordfence loader lines|none of these files
tests: a plugin state table the copy has never had comes whole from the live site once, then stays the copy’s (#106)
a WordPress object cache drop-in is the copy’s own: the live site’s never comes over (#106)
the Wordfence loader lines are commented out; every other rule stays as it was
a webroot with none of these files is left alone
